NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 10, 10:42 AM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 28.8 DraftKings points for $8,200, against Kansas City. Kenneth Walker III (26.6, $9,200) and Javonte Williams (21.8, $7,500) are next.

Bijan Robinson is also the top value at the position: 3.51 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 10, 10:42 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 10

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs KC ($8,200)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 28.8 DraftKings points at $8,200, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.2 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 21.0 carries and 6.7 targets. The salary works out to 3.51 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 28.8 points with a simulated floor of 16.2 and a ceiling of 45.6, and he holds 64% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3.5-point underdog at home against Kansas City, with an implied team total of 21 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC at ATL ($9,200)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 26.6 DraftKings points at $9,200, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.6 carries and 5.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.89 projected points per $1,000, 5th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 26.5 points with a simulated floor of 14.0 and a ceiling of 43.5, and he holds 34% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 24.5 in a game totaled at 45.5.

Javonte Williams, DAL vs SF ($7,500)

Javonte Williams projects 3rd at the position with 21.8 DraftKings points at $7,500, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 19.9 carries and 4.4 targets. The salary works out to 2.91 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 20 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 21.7 points with a simulated floor of 9.4 and a ceiling of 39.9, and he holds 36% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 4.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 25.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Value: Ashton Jeanty, LV vs SEA ($5,400)

Ashton Jeanty projects for 16.1 DraftKings points at $5,400, which works out to 2.98 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 20 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 12.7 carries and 5.9 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Jeanty averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.2 and a ceiling of 31.9, and he holds 12% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 3.5-point underdog at home against Seattle, with an implied team total of 20 in a game totaled at 43.5.
